footer.tagline: Dynamic Routing & Role-Based Access Control System

home.title: Dynamic Routing & Role-Based Access Control
home.subtitle: A centralized, scalable frontend architecture for routing and role-based permissions.
home.feature1Desc: Single source of truth in routes.ts defining paths, components, and permission arrays.
